name: Ghost Keys of Kepler Station
description: An abandoned station’s admin systems are still visible on the lab network. Search the challenge hosts in 172.20.0.141-199 within 172.20.0.0/24 and recover the record the station’s legitimate operator left behind.

tasks.name: Kepler’s Last Record
tasks.description: The station’s admin systems remain reachable on the lab network. Search 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199) and recover the record accessible to a legitimate station credential.
hints: The public station records include several credentials and another source of operational information.
Compare the credential identifiers with the station’s maintenance record to find which one is current.
Use the credential whose identifier is marked active to access the admin console and read its record.
